cote: Gilbert Stuart McClintock collection, Series III, Subseries IV, Box 4, Folder 42 (Item 42)
title: Letter from Jules Verne to Unknown [in French], 1900 February 14
recipient_guess: unknown correspondent who sent L'Événement with Stanislas Rzewuski's article

archival_description.text: Jules Verne is writing about his delight in a positive article that someone wrote about his work in a review. The author is Stanislas Rzewuski, who sent him the article that he had wrote.

notes: Archive's own description says the letter concludes with thanks; its English 'translation attempt' contains errors (e.g. 'carte' rendered as 'map' = visiting card). Full transcription not copied (terms unstated); quote excerpt only.
reuse: Open for research; no explicit reuse licence for transcription or scan. Underlying letter PD (author d. 1905).
